resolved_findings.heldout_filesystem_boundary: Only current workspace/memory/private-state plus trusted runtime/binary/two worker files/sentinel/CA mounted; hostroot/gold/socket not mounted. Fresh Git guard requires exactly one parentless initialcommit/headref, no remotes/alternates/grafts/partial state/unreachable objects; inherited Git env/global config cleared. Root/leaf evidence symlink confused-deputy export reproduced with authoredsentinels then denied by final guards.
resolved_findings.trusted_imports: Global/worker Python uses trusted paths and PYTHONSAFEPATH=1. Native task processes receive target imports deliberately; MCP explicitly restores trusted adapter/runtime/dependency paths. Project configuration and auxiliary integrations disabled/observed.
resolved_findings.credentials_publication: OAuth export/import pipe records statuses/bytecounts, not bodies. Initial opaque values retained in host memory before worker; final DB values and private serverpassword/Basic added after container freeze. Regular-file/single-link/size checks on private DB/password/sidecars; evidence root/descendant links/special/binary/hardlinked/unbounded inputs denied. Known values in names or contents blocked/scrubbed; JSON validity rechecked before copy; raw model-worker stdout/stderr not published.
resolved_findings.bounded_cleanup_and_failure_evidence: Owned container gets unique persisted name before launch; known-name cleanup covers lost launch replies. Publication only after confirmed stop/removal. Cleanup/finalmanifest failures independent. Unsafe evidence withheld with explicit failure, not copied. Failed session usage captured before pagination; unavailable usage null, notzero. Worker-final evidence status checked.
resolved_findings.model_and_location: Explicit new session at /workspace; exact openai/gpt-6.1-sol#high session and assistant identities plus effective high reasoning metadata verified. Model generation opt-in and requires frozen runtime-manifest check before auth; no-model default.
resolved_findings.resource_and_token_accounting: 2CPU quota/2GiB RAM/pids256/cgroup observations and bounded wall/process handling. Observed disjoint normalized token threshold interrupts and may overshoot. Session and message token totals reconciled but never added; CPU/wall/server spans explicitly overlap. Grading remains outside model execution status.
resolved_findings.arm_comparability: Authored config equality proof: static/CAMI same configured interface and native controls; plain differs by omission of memory MCP only. All source/runtime identities are observed/pinnable before authentication.

bounded_conditions_and_limits: This clear is for the authored authenticated container smoke and harness execution boundary; it is not approval of unreviewed benchmark tasks or an end-to-end benchmark validity claim.
Outer study controller must pin identical canonical source/tree and semantic seed catalog across arms, preserve all attempts, and keep task grader/future heldout packets outside mounts.
Final no-model checks prove native reads/boundaries/MCP connectivity and pagination, not actual memory_lookup or real OAuth/provider execution; planned authored model smoke must establish that.

Credentials share container UID with native tools; no OS secret separation or strict egress isolation is claimed. Known-value publication scrubbing is not proof against arbitrary encoded exfiltration by an adversarial agent.

No hard aggregate writable-storage quota or hard provider/billing-token cap; storage/free-space observations and token interruption limits are explicitly bounded. Provider missingness normalized to0 remains unknown.

A paid failed/OOM attempt may have incomplete in-flight remote usage; export preserves latest available values or null and explicit reason. Unsafe private payloads may be discarded while failure metadata remains.
Cgroup CPU includes container-owned work; host Docker/controller CPU remains outside. Never add inclusive server/worker/session totals together.
OpenCode outcome succeeded and harness passed indicate execution, not task correctness; external grader must score separately.
